title: Tensor sections describe change of topology for arbitrary scheme modules
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with Zariski site $T_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ of open subschemes and small etale site $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. On the latter put $\mathcal O_{T,\mathrm{et}}(u:V\to T)=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$. The inclusion of open subschemes induces a morphism of ringed sites $\epsilon_T:(T_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal O_{T,\mathrm{et}})\to(T_{\mathrm{Zar}},\mathcal O_T)$ whose module direct image is restriction: $(\epsilon_{T,*}G)(W)=G(W\hookrightarrow T)$ for each open $W\subseteq T$. For every sheaf $M$ of $\mathcal O_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], without any quasi-coherence hypothesis, there is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\mathcal O_{T,\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\epsilon_T^{-1}\mathcal O_T}\epsilon_T^{-1}M\ \simeq\ \big(u:V\to T\longmapsto\Gamma(V,u^*M)\big)^{\#}.$$
Here tensor product is [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], $u^*M$ is scheme module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and $\#$ is module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. The presheaf restrictions are pullback of sections followed by the canonical composition isomorphisms, and its action on a module morphism $h$ is $\Gamma(V,u^*h)$.
